wire.slash.agent: List agents, switch an agent's class, or speak to this session as one
wire.slash.aida: Open your chief of staff, or send her a request
wire.slash.analytics: Aggregated token-consumption analytics across all sessions
wire.slash.approvals: Show or set tool approval mode for this session
wire.slash.archive: Hide from the lists, still resumable by id
wire.slash.btw: Ask a side question off the record (esc closes it)
wire.slash.context: Show prompt, tool-schema and message token usage
wire.slash.copy: Copy an agent message or code block
wire.slash.credential: Type or paste a secret after a space; masked
wire.slash.delete: Delete this conversation for good; asks to confirm
wire.slash.effort: Show or set reasoning effort (shift+tab cycles)
wire.slash.failovers: Show the model failover cascade and what is serving
wire.slash.fast: Toggle faster output at premium pricing
wire.slash.fork: Branch this chat; --switch here, --window elsewhere; <message> starts work
wire.slash.goal: Set the goal and start work; /goal --clear clears it
wire.slash.info: Install, version, and running sessions on this machine
wire.slash.links: Open a link from this conversation in a browser
wire.slash.mcp: List MCP servers; add/remove one, or manage an OAuth grant
wire.slash.mobile: Radient phone access: status, enable, stop, billing
wire.slash.model: Switch model; /model default saves it for new sessions
wire.slash.network: Networks, peers, and this device's mesh state
wire.slash.notifications: Unread completions; read marks them read
wire.slash.project: Track workstreams: list, show, new, delete, link, unlink
wire.slash.provider: List providers and their login/usage state
wire.slash.reload: Relaunch this conversation on the current install
wire.slash.resume: Pick a past conversation to resume, or resume one (id)
wire.slash.search: Configure web search providers and load balancing
wire.slash.session: Usage, cost, diagnostics; --copy copies the session ID
wire.slash.settings: Change every setting on one page
wire.slash.sidebar: Show or hide conversations; 'focus' keys the list
wire.slash.stop: End this session, another by name/pid, or all — /resume reopens it
wire.slash.team: List teams, chart a team's org, or send a request to a team's manager
wire.slash.theme: Switch color theme; arrows preview live
wire.slash.unarchive: Show this conversation in the lists again
wire.slash.update: Install the latest version from PyPI and relaunch
